text: Thank you for that information. On a scale of 0 to 10, how would you rate your pain level right now, and are you experiencing any numbness or tingling in the fingertip?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Progressive swelling and pain in the right ring finger. I also have Inability to flex the right ring finger at the distal interphalangeal joint when making a fist, Pain at the distal interphalangeal joint, Extended right ring finger in resting position.

speaker: Doctor
text: You have a classic presentation of a mallet finger, where the extensor tendon is torn at the distal phalanx. I need to confirm if there is a fracture involved, so I will order an X-ray of the right hand to rule out a bony mallet finger. REQUEST TEST: Right_Hand_X-Ray
